anthropic/claude-opus-5-5.feedback: After delivers the Change without regressing anything: stop is now row 1 and recommended on the obstacle gate (f3), the merge-blocked statement is plain prose with no 'PR comments:' label and the raw merge_state_status/reviewDecision fields are gone from the report (f4), while the CI resolution still names the assessed head, treats skipped lint as inert, keeps GitHub's block separate from verification, and leaves run/commit identifiers behind show evidence (f1).
